resources.string: That computer offered only addresses this phone cannot reach. Put both on the same network and open pairing mode again.
Checking that your computer is reachable.
Accept the request Tennyo shows in the editor on your computer.
Open pairing mode in Tennyo on your computer, then connect again.
Tap the %1$d words your computer shows, in order.
Your computer sent an unusable set of words. Open pairing mode again.
This version of the app cannot pair with that computer. Update both to the latest version.
The pairing could not be confirmed.
That was not the right order. Check the words on your computer and tap them again.
The pairing words have expired. Open pairing mode again on your computer.
Pairing stopped after too many incorrect attempts. Open pairing mode again on your computer.
Waiting for your computer to accept the session.
The connection dropped. Tennyo is reconnecting.
This session expired or was ended on your computer. Connect again to start a new one.
Tennyo could not reach your computer.
Not connected to your computer yet.
The connection timed out. Connect again to start a new session.
Your computer could not complete the request
Unable to connect to your computer
Your computer offered no address this phone can reach
The connection closed before your computer started syncing.
The connection to your computer closed.

Your computer did not accept the connection. Put the phone and computer on the same Wi-Fi, turn off VPN and the router\'s client isolation, and let your editor accept local network connections (Windows Firewall, or Local Network on macOS). Then try again.

Your computer did not accept the connection at %1$s. Put the phone and computer on the same Wi-Fi, turn off VPN and the router\'s client isolation, and let your editor accept local network connections (Windows Firewall, or Local Network on macOS). Then try again.
